existing_fixture_scope: Native-format/filter/Adam7 geometry matrix, APNG render/recovery, exact native sample bytes on 84 external/format files; primary lookup all 65,536 two-byte values and independent widths/padding; one-bit literal lengths 0..63; every legal match length/distance at eight bit offsets, fixed/dynamic trees and both padding values; prefix/suffix and exact/short limits; PNG/APNG/Adam7 and metadata in the full release suite.
performance_scope: Reuse ordinary eight-bit filtered buffers for native samples and cap on-demand inflation growth requests at the output limit. Repeated photo decode +5.28% relative to Rust png (unchanged reader +1.86%); format decode +10.28% (reader +0.26%) and raw inflate +18.36% relative to flate2 (unchanged streaming +2.78%). Photo raw inflation is inconclusive. Exact native bytes agree on 84 inputs; cohort capacities show lower inflation storage and removal of the second full byte-sample buffer. Shared-host measurements do not prove broad parity. Longer checks clear the original PNG regressions, but stored-only gray8 Adam7 raw inflation remains 9.02 to 11.02 microseconds, -28.49% relative to flate2 and -12.03% relative to unchanged streaming inflation. Retain this explicit allocation/throughput tradeoff; no uniform raw-inflate speedup is claimed.
